_note: CI runs every .github/scripts/Tests/*.Tests.ps1 EXCEPT the files listed here.
Adding an entry is how a suite gets skipped; there is no allowlist to forget to update.
class: unclassified = never measured on Linux, a BACKLOG that should shrink to zero.
class: linux-red    = measured failing on the CI platform. Temporary, so an issue number is REQUIRED.
class: never-ci     = structurally cannot run in CI (live gh, network, interactive terminal). Permanent and legitimate.
Enforced by .github/scripts/Tests/ci-suite-registration.Tests.ps1, which fails if any suite on disk is neither run nor listed here.
